description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'ProductListActivity' class for an Android application. It handles UI interactions for displaying a list of products with filtering, searching, paging, preset management, and state synchronization. The class manages adapters, view models, and user controls, as well as state and view updates related to product browsing.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the display of product lists with filtering, ordering, paging, preset saving/loading, and UI state synchronization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, adapters, view models, and data collection coroutines.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures subtle item animations for RecyclerView.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Sets up actions for clearing filters, saving/loading presets, and managing preset dialogs.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Initializes search input, category spinner, and price chips with listeners to update filters.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI controls with the current search query and filter state, especially after preset application.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays current active filters as removable chips below search input.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to save current filters as a preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays a list of saved presets with options to apply or delete.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Displays options (apply/delete) for a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Confirms and executes deletion of a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates the empty state message based on active filters and search query.
